column8: All non-benchmark source test shapes are represented, including nil-slice identity through Option. Live parser hot-type allocation is not wired; benchmark artifacts are executable regression workloads, not timing measurements.
Default initialization, mutation, distinct storage, and earlier allocation stability execute exactly.
Length, default values, mutation, and the zero-length nil result match; Option distinguishes nil from an allocated Vec.
Reset followed by default-initialized allocation executes and live earlier storage remains valid.
Twenty 4096-byte generic allocations have stable distinct storage.
A value twice the source block size remains mutable and does not prevent later small allocation.
Managed String and pointer fields survive owner reset through typed reference-counted batches.
SLAB_SIZE plus ten allocations cross the batch boundary with unique stable identities.
Equivalent reset and allocation loop is an all-targets regression workload, not a registered timing benchmark; comparative measurements are not established.
